## 0. The lenses — and which are new

Four mandatory lenses: **(a) bugs, (b) gaps in logic, (c) verbiage, (d) page structure.** (a) and (b) have been run in eight prior rounds (correctness, security, the deploy runbook, data truth); (c) and (d) had never been run as their own passes — P5 (three verbiage passes over an instrumented string inventory) and P6 (structure / IA from an instrumented crawl) are new this round. P2 (PHP runtime compatibility on a `[UNSOURCED]` production version), P10 (performance re-check from the crawl) and P11 (the harness auditing itself) are the other lenses; P1, P3, P4, P7, P8, P9 re-verify by measurement, never re-derive.

### 1.5 STEP 0 — is the site live? (§4.6)

**NOT LIVE.** Verbatim record: `_harness/out/audit9/step0.md`. All three `/data/*.json` answer **404** (host's stock 2007 error page) over plain HTTP; HTTPS on both apex and `www` presents `CN=*.hostingplatform.com` (Sectigo DV), **expired** and not issued for this hostname (`openssl s_client … Verify return code: 10 (certificate has expired)`) — so every `https://` line is `[UNVERIFIED — TLS]`, not "down"; `http://www.insulationproducts.com/` answers `302 → /site/` (server `openresty`), not the runbook's expected `301 → https`. Runbook branch: **B, first deploy.** No live/repo data diff exists; the repo copies are the audit's truth.
